decisions.reason: Although this drink mix is less central and less visibly committed than the firm's core industrial technologies, it is only one year old and management can still justify keeping it as an early-stage extension rather than admitting a failed launch.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the established business, likely required meaningful engineering investment across several models, and a growing market makes it easy for management to continue rather than reverse course.

As a flagship product with its own page and clear strategic importance, this waste-oil-to-energy plant is exactly the kind of public, investment-heavy commitment that escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to abandon.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's core offer and was presented as a flagship direction, so management is likely to defend the investment and keep it on the market despite any early uncertainty.
